map.输入密码实时评估安全强度。从字符种类、长度、复杂度、常见模式多维度分析，估算破解: Enter a password to evaluate its security strength in real time. It analyzes character types, length, complexity and common patterns from multiple dimensions, estimates cracking time and gives improvement suggestions. Passwords are processed locally only and never uploaded.
map.📖 查看「密码强度检测（安全） 使用指南」: 📖 Read the Password Strength Checker (Security) user guide
map.强度分按维度累加：长度分（不足 8 位 0 分、8 至 11 位 10 分、12: Strength score accumulates by dimension: length score (under 8 characters 0 points, 8 to 11 characters 10 points, 12 to 15 characters 20 points, 16 characters or more 30 points) + character set score (upper and lower case, digits, symbols 15 to 25 points each) − penalties (consecutive or repeated characters, weak password dictionary hits); cracking time = character set size ^ length ÷ attempts per second (about 10¹⁰ per second offline), under 1 second is extremely weak and over 100 years is very strong.
map.密码在浏览器本地分析，不会发送到任何服务器，可放心使用: Passwords are analyzed locally in the browser and never sent to any server, so use it with confidence
map.评分维度：字符种类（大写/小写/数字/特殊符号）、长度、字符多样性、常见模式检测: Scoring dimensions: character types (upper/lower case, digits, special symbols), length, character diversity, common pattern detection
map.破解时间基于普通计算机每秒 10 亿次哈希计算估算，实际取决于攻击者算力: Cracking time is estimated on the basis of 10 billion hashes per second on an ordinary computer; the real figure depends on the attacker's computing power
map.建议密码长度 ≥12 位，包含大小写字母、数字和特殊符号，避免使用个人信息: Password length ≥12 characters is recommended, including upper and lower case letters, digits and special symbols, and avoid using personal information
map.不同网站/服务请使用不同密码，推荐使用密码管理器: Use different passwords for different websites and services, and a password manager is recommended
map.输入口令即时估算熵值，量化被暴力破解的难度，提示是否达标。: Enter a password to instantly estimate its entropy, quantifying how hard it is to brute force, and flag whether it is up to standard.
map.按字符集大小评估：仅数字、加字母、再加符号，熵呈对数增长。: Assess by character set size: digits only, then adding letters, then adding symbols makes entropy grow logarithmically.
map.对照目标安全等级（如 60 bit 以上）给出改进建议。: Compare against a target security level (such as 60 bit or more) and give improvement suggestions.
map.口令熵（bit）= 长度 × log2(字符池大小)。字符池：纯数字 10、加小: Password entropy (bit) = length × log2(pool size). Pool: digits only 10, adding lowercase 36, adding
map.62、再加符号约 95。熵越高越难暴力破解；一般建议 ≥ 60 bit，高安全: 62, adding symbols about 95. Higher entropy is harder to brute force; generally ≥ 60 bit is advised, high security ≥ 80 bit.
map.8 位纯数字：8×log2(10)≈26.6 bit（很弱）；8 位大小写+数字: 8 digits only: 8×log2(10)≈26.6 bit (very weak); 8 characters of upper/lower case plus digits: 8×log2(62)≈47.6 bit; 12 characters with symbols: 12×log2(95)≈78.6 bit (passes). "password" is long but has a small and common character pool, so dictionary words should still be avoided.
map.不一定。若口令是常见词典词或键盘规律（如 asdf1234），即使字符集大也会被: Not necessarily. If the password is a common dictionary word or follows a keyboard pattern (such as asdf1234), it can still be cracked by dictionary or rule-based attacks even with a large character set; randomness and non-dictionary structure matter.
map.含符号的 12 位以上通常 ≥ 75 bit，配合密码管理器生成随机口令最稳妥；: 12 characters or more including symbols usually reaches ≥ 75 bit, and generating random passwords with a password manager is safest; add two-factor authentication for important accounts.
map.实时密码强度评估工具，从字符种类、长度、信息熵、常见弱密码模式等维度综合评分，估: A real-time password strength evaluation tool that scores comprehensively across character types, length, information entropy and common weak password patterns, estimates brute force time, and helps users set secure and reliable passwords.
map.实时分析密码强度并可视化展示: Real-time password strength analysis with visual presentation
map.检测常见弱密码、连续序列、重复字符等模式: Detection of common weak passwords, consecutive sequences and repeated characters
map.计算信息熵并估算暴力破解时间: Information entropy computation and brute force time estimation
map.纯前端处理，密码不上传服务器: Pure front-end processing, passwords never uploaded to the server
map.设置重要账号密码前的安全检查: Security check before setting an important account password
